goal.answer: Recreate macOS Tahoe's full desktop interface — Liquid Glass design language, desktop shell with window manager, and ~20 working built-in apps — as a faithful, interactive single-page web app using mock/local data persisted to localStorage.

criteria.answer:
`pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm test` all exit 0.
Playwright e2e suite passes covering: desktop shell renders (#menubar, #dock, .desktop), window manager (open/drag/resize/minimize-genie/close/fullscreen/Spaces), menu bar dropdowns (Apple menu + app menus with working items), and Spotlight (Cmd+Space) / Control Center / Notification Center panels.

System Settings Playwright tests pass: sidebar navigation (Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, etc.) and a control that changes desktop state (appearance toggle / menu-bar background).
Notes Playwright test passes: create/edit/delete/search plus persistence across a full page reload.
Calculator: Vitest unit tests pass for the arithmetic engine and Playwright e2e passes for UI + keyboard input.
Safari Playwright tests pass: tabs, bookmarks bar, start page, and address-bar navigation over bundled mock pages (no real network).
Each additional app (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, Clock, Reminders) has a passing Playwright smoke test asserting its Tahoe UI renders and one core interaction works.
Appearance modes (Light/Dark/Tinted) and Reduce Transparency toggle visibly change glass surfaces, asserted by a test checking the root class/state.
End-to-end persistence test passes: notes + virtual filesystem changes + settings survive a full page reload via localStorage.
Liquid Glass visual fidelity verified by a visual-regression snapshot on core shell components plus a recorded manual inspection against Tahoe reference screenshots.

assumptions.answer: Greenfield project: the working directory /Users/mike/tmp/Ferment-GLM5.2 is empty, so Step 4 deep codebase exploration is skipped — there is no existing code to read. Tech stack assumed safe/standard and current as of scoping: Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind CSS v4 via the official @tailwindcss/vite plugin with `@import \"tailwindcss\"` and @theme tokens; state management via Zustand with the persist middleware to localStorage; testing via Playwright (e2e) and Vitest (unit), managed with pnpm. These are reversible defaults; if a chosen version is unavailable the implementer may pin the nearest stable. SF Pro is not freely licensed, so typography uses the -apple-system font stack as a faithful approximation. Real macOS wallpapers and app icons are copyrighted, so the project uses original gradient/SVG wallpapers and approximated SVG app icons. Calendar and Clock use the real current date/time; all other additional apps (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Reminders) use seeded mock data. The interview confirmed: include all app areas (desktop shell, Finder, Safari, Notes+Calculator, System Settings, and ~10 additional apps); apps are functional with local/mock data (no real services); visual fidelity is faithful Liquid Glass. Completion criteria were confirmed by the user with no changes.

charter.intent: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working
charter.wowFactor: A web app that genuinely feels like sitting at a Mac running Tahoe — real Liquid Glass translucency over a wallpaper, magnifying Dock, genie minimize, Spotlight, and 20+ apps you can actually use with data that survives a reload.
charter.confirmedScope: In: full desktop shell + window manager + Spotlight/Control Center/Notification Center; faithful Liquid Glass design system (real translucency); Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator, and Safari fully functional with local data; ~10 additional apps (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, Clock, Reminders) as interactive Tahoe UIs with mock data; appearance modes (Light/Dark/Tinted) + Reduce Transparency toggle; localStorage persistence; Playwright e2e + Vitest unit tests. Out: real backend services, real network fetches, Apple's copyrighted wallpapers/icons/fonts, iCloud sync, Siri/Apple Intelligence/AI features.
charter.demoScript: Load the app and see a Tahoe desktop with a transparent glass menu bar (floating icons) and a magnifying Dock. Click an app in the Dock — a window opens with Liquid Glass chrome and squircle corners. Press Cmd+Space for Spotlight, search and launch Calculator, and do real math. Open Notes, create a note, reload the page — the note persists. Open System Settings, toggle the appearance, and watch the entire desktop switch modes.

memory.content: pnpm 11.5.2 requires `onlyBuiltDependencies` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (not package.json's `pnpm` field, not .npmrc). Format: YAML list under `onlyBuiltDependencies:` key. Without it, `pnpm install` exits 1 with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS for esbuild. The packages still link correctly, but the exit code blocks scripted verification. Fix: create pnpm-workspace.yaml with `onlyBuiltDependencies:\n  - esbuild`.

payload.summary:
Phase 2 (Desktop Shell & Window Manager) complete. All 5 steps done, all 4 grader recommendations addressed:

1. **Spaces keyboard shortcuts wired**: Added Ctrl+ArrowRight/ArrowLeft handlers in WindowManager.tsx calling nextSpace()/prevSpace(). Works even without a focused window.
2. **Dock bounce animation fixed**: Removed dead `<style>` keyframes block. Bounce now applied directly via inline `transform: translateY(-20px)` with spring easing transition on the button element. The no-op `scale: bouncedApp === app.id ? scale : scale` ternary replaced with plain `scale`.
3. **Deprecated store methods**: `updateWindowPosition` and `updateWindowSize` marked `@deprecated` with JSDoc — they're API-compatibility aliases that delegate to `setWindowPosition`/`setWindowSize` which Window.tsx actually uses.
4. **Spaces test strengthened**: `window-manager.spec.ts` Spaces test now asserts the window is `not.toBeVisible()` after switching to Space 1 via Ctrl+ArrowRight, then asserts it's visible again after switching back via Ctrl+ArrowLeft.

**Test results**: 44 Playwright e2e tests pass (3 shell-desktop + 7 shell-menubar + 7 shell-dock + 11 window-manager + 16 shell-panels). 43 Vitest unit tests pass. Build and lint clean.

grade.rationale: All 5 shell components are implemented, wired together in Desktop.tsx, and verified with 44 passing Playwright e2e tests and 43 Vitest unit tests (both re-run independently). All 4 grader fixes confirmed in source: Spaces Ctrl+Arrow shortcuts in WindowManager.tsx:36-50, Dock bounce via inline transform with spring easing in Dock.tsx:57-66, @deprecated JSDoc in windows.ts:52-54, and the strengthened Spaces test asserting visibility changes. Build and lint are clean. However, the 'genie minimize' is just display:none with no actual animation (a deviation from the explicitly-stated 'genie' wow factor), and 4 grader fixes were needed including a missing feature (Spaces shortcuts), indicating the first delivery wasn't clean.
recommendations: Genie minimize is implemented as display:none with no animation (Window.tsx minimize branch). The phase goal explicitly lists 'minimize-to-Dock (genie)' and the charter lists 'genie minimize' as a wow factor. To reach A, add a CSS keyframe animation that scales/translates the window toward the Dock position before hiding it. Evidence: a Playwright test asserting the window has a transform animation applied during the minimize transition (not just display:none).

The void windows; void currentSpace; pattern in Desktop.tsx is a code smell that forces re-renders via unused variable references. Replace with a proper selector subscription (e.g., useWindowStore with shallow equality) so the component re-renders naturally when windows/space change. Evidence: the component re-renders correctly without the void statements.

payload.finalSummary:
macOS Tahoe Web Recreation — complete. All 6 phases done, all grader recommendations addressed.

**Grader fixes applied:**
1. **Genie minimize animation implemented**: Added @keyframes genie-minimize (scale 1→0.05, translateY 0→100vh, opacity 1→0) using the existing --ease-genie CSS variable. Window.tsx now renders minimized windows with the window-minimizing class and onAnimationEnd handler that hides the element after the 0.4s animation completes. Playwright test verifies: window has window-minimizing class, getComputedStyle().animationName === 'genie-minimize', window becomes not visible after animation.
2. **C2 gate reconciled**: Genie minimize is no longer deferred — it is fully implemented with CSS animation + test verification. Visual inspection notes updated to reflect implementation rather than deferral.
3. **Spotlight synthetic event**: Documented as known environment limitation — macOS intercepts Meta+Space at OS level, so test dispatches synthetic KeyboardEvent on window (where Desktop.tsx listener is attached). This is the correct approach for this environment constraint.

**Final test results:**
- pnpm build: ✓ 73 modules, 323.46 kB JS (92.99 kB gzip), 55.00 kB CSS
- pnpm lint: ✓ No issues found
- Vitest: 67 tests passed (calculator engine 21, settings store 22, design primitives 21, app registry 3)
- Playwright: 117 tests passed across 14 spec files (shell 44, finder 11, settings 6, notes 6, calculator 10, safari 6, additional-apps 10, visual-regression 10, appearance-modes 10, persistence-e2e 4)
- Total: 184 tests passing

grade.rationale: Independently verified: pnpm build (73 modules, 323 kB JS), pnpm lint (clean), and all 184 tests pass (67 Vitest + 117 Playwright across 14 spec files). Genie minimize is genuinely implemented: @keyframes genie-minimize in src/styles/main.css, window-minimizing class + onAnimationEnd in src/shell/Window.tsx, and e2e/window-manager.spec.ts:105 asserts getComputedStyle().animationName === 'genie-minimize' and window becomes not visible. All 15 apps (4 core + Safari + 10 additional) are real registered components in registry.tsx. Real Liquid Glass translucency via backdrop-filter: blur()+saturate() on .glass-surface classes with reduce-transparency toggle. Appearance modes (light/dark/tinted) + reduce-transparency all tested with html class assertions. Persistence across reload verified for n

charterVerdicts.clause: Recreate macOS Tahoe full desktop interface as interactive SPA
charterVerdicts.evidence: Desktop.tsx renders wallpaper, glass menubar (#menubar), magnifying Dock (#dock), .desktop; 44 shell e2e tests pass

charterVerdicts.clause: Liquid Glass design language with real translucency
charterVerdicts.evidence: src/styles/main.css: backdrop-filter: blur()+saturate() on .glass-surface classes; visual-regression.spec.ts asserts computedStyle.backdropFilter on menubar/dock/panels
window-manager.spec.ts: 11 tests covering open/drag/resize/minimize-genie/close/fullscreen/Spaces; Window.tsx has traffic lights, z-index, drag, resize handle

registry.tsx registers 15 apps (Finder, Safari, Mail, Notes, Calculator, Settings, Music, Photos, Messages, Terminal, Calendar, Weather, Stocks, Clock, Reminders); all have passing e2e tests with core interactions

charterVerdicts.clause: Finder fully functional with local data
